faq.a: Character mode reverses every character (abc becomes cba). Word mode keeps each word intact but reverses their order. Line mode reverses the order of the lines.
faq.q: What is the difference between the modes?

faq.a: Yes — characters are reversed by Unicode code point, so accented letters and most emojis stay intact instead of breaking into pieces.

whenNotToUse: Reversed text is a novelty/format effect — screen readers and search engines will read it literally, so don't use it for content that must be accessible.
Character reversal will break right-to-left scripts and complex emoji sequences (such as flags and family emojis).
